JobCreate.description:
Exactly one of ``upload_id`` / ``file_url``.

Effective provider: ``provider`` if given, else ``options.provider`` if the client set it,
else the settings default; the server stores it in ``options.provider``. ``local`` is rejected
(422) until M5 (D4), and ``file_url`` jobs are cloud-only (D3). ``options.terms`` is rebuilt
server-side from ``term_set_ids`` + ``extra_terms``.

MP3 cache) is removed too, unless another job still references it.

post.description: Create a term set from pasted text / a .txt file's contents (see ``parse_terms``).

patch.description:
Apply ops to ``segments`` only; ``original`` is immutable (rule 8).

All ops are validated before anything is written (all-or-nothing).

post.description:
``segments <- original``. Speaker names/colours are kept; any speaker id used by the
original but missing from the list is added back.

put.description: Rename / recolour existing speakers; speakers not listed are unchanged.

post.description:
Single-request multipart upload (curl; the UI uses chunked upload, D11).

Form fields: ``file`` (the audio/video file) and ``target_dir`` (absolute, or relative to the
first upload root).
Start a chunked upload: ``total_parts`` parts of ``part_size`` bytes (last one shorter).
Register a file that already exists inside an upload root (no transfer).
Assemble the parts in order into ``target_dir`` and probe the result.

put.description:
Raw part body (``application/octet-stream``); read via ``request.stream()``.

Every part must be exactly ``part_size`` bytes except the last. Re-sending a part replaces
it (idempotent).
